text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Accompanying Nishino Flower, I came to 
watch the blooming of the "flower that 
only blooms at night" that she had been 
raising. One night—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... It should be about time for it to 
bloom, and yet...—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: *Yawn*...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: —Ah! I-I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"...Um. Normally it's around my bedtime, 
so... I just—"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I want to do my best tonight...! I 
want to watch this little one bloom—"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Besides... I have a feeling that tonight, 
this little one will finally bloom.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. If you feel that way too, Trainer, 
then surely—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: —Ah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Right where Nishino Flower was looking, 
the bud began to stir ever so slightly. It 
was clearly the precursor to blooming...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: "Hang in there...! Just a little more...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Together with Nishino Flower, I watched 
with bated breath. Before long—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—A large flower bloomed beneath the 
moonlit sky, instantly dispersing a soft 
fragrance.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Wah--

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A flower glowing as if harboring moonlight 
within. Alongside Nishino Flower, I gazed 
in speechless awe at the fantastical 
blossom for a while—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Trainer. Thank you for today.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Being able to witness her blossom together 
with you... made me so, so happy!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...I want to bloom proudly in full glory, 
just like her.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I want to shine so bright, that's what I 
thought...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: That's why—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"From tomorrow on as well... I'll be 
counting on you!"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ehehe—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Well then, Trainer... Good night.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The brilliance of the flowers we saw today 
would become an unforgettable memory for 
Nishino Flower and myself. That night left 
me certain of it—
